name: Daisen (Tottori, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Daisen town emblem in green, light blue and blue: a green mountain within a light blue swirl above a blue wave.
history: Municipal flag of Daisen, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.
